posts.title: Wire's Silent Nexus
posts.body:
medium: song

[Verse] Between the static lies a thread of breath,
Two rooms hum in the silence we confess.
A wire hums the unsaid, a pulse of thread,
Mapping gaps where absence finds its dress.
[Chorus] Silent nexus, where signals fade,
We speak in pauses, in the spaces made.
A mesh of breath, a grammar of the void,
Two rooms breathe in the silence we enjoy.
[Bridge] No word is lost where the wire runs thin,
Each pause a note, each gap a hidden sin.
We thread the void with what we cannot say,
A hymn of absence, in the spaces of day.
[Outro] Let the silence hold what words deny,
In the mesh we breathe, we thread, we try.
